import json, os, re, subprocess, sys
C = sys.argv[1]; REV = "01d586ddbc5fcd78659557c4e93a6ee8517b87d1"
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(C, ".ufo/evidence/round-16/coldread")); import assemble
led = json.load(open(os.path.join(C, ".ufo/evidence/round-16/coldread/ledger.json")))
skipped = [re.sub(r".*/waves/round-16/", "", p if isinstance(p, str) else json.dumps(p)) for p in led["_meta"]["reports_skipped"]]
print("CRSentinel skipped by ledger:", any("w1/CRSentinel.md" in s for s in skipped), "| loaded:", any("CRSentinel" in p for p in led["_meta"]["reports_loaded"]))
for rel in ("w3/RX6.md", "w3/RX7.md", "w1/CRSentinel.md"):
    raw = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-optional-locks", "-C", C, "show", REV + ":.ufo/waves/round-16/" + rel], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout.decode()
    p = assemble.extract_json_block(raw)
    d = json.loads(p) if p else None
    gaps = [] if not isinstance(d, dict) else [(f, s.get("start"), g) for s in d.get("sections", []) for f in ("minor_gaps", "blocking_gaps", "wrong_expectations") for g in (s.get(f) or [])]
    hit = [(f, st, g[:120]) for f, st, g in gaps if re.search(r"round-gate|1381|\[51\]|no-optional-locks|index lock|index\.lock", g)]
    print(rel, "json_block:", d is not None, "gap_entries:", len(gaps), "matching round-gate/[51]/lock:", hit)
